title: Emerald Set
description: Give yourself Emerald Armor, Tools, and more in Minecraft!
body:
Introducing the Minecraft Emerald Gear Mod!
Included in this mod:
- Emerald Armor
- Emerald Tools
- Emerald Sword with special abilites.
- Ender Wand that can teleport you.
Have fun with this special gear set!
- Note: Emerald Shield is bugged out, and only obtainable with cheats. Command is /give @s emerald_tools:emerald_shield
- Credit to https://modrinth.com/user/Stevemine26
